title: Abbreviated condition — IF X = 1 OR 2 OR 3 means IF X = 1 OR X = 2 OR X = 3
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. STATUS-CHECK.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-STATE  PIC 9.
       01  WS-MSG    PIC X(20).
      *> The condition 'WS-STATE = 1 OR 2 OR 3' is abbreviated:
      *> the second and third '2' and '3' inherit the LHS 'WS-STATE
      *> ='. Translating to Java's WS-STATE == 1 || 2 || 3 is
      *> nonsensical because Java treats 2 and 3 as integer truthiness
      *> (always true).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           IF WS-STATE = 1 OR 2 OR 3
              MOVE "active" TO WS-MSG
           END-IF.
notes: Abbreviated conditions are the COBOL equivalent of Python's 'x in {1,2,3}'. A literal port to Java 'x == 1 || 2 || 3' is wrong (because 2 is truthy). Surface this so the rewrite uses a set-membership check.
